mechanism.claim: When robust canonical-dollar factors computed independently over the first and second halves of the completed New York FX session have one common strict direction, global dollar repricing has persisted rather than arrived as a terminal close shock. If BTC variation is elevated and the weaker phase is still unusually large, inverse dollar transmission should continue into BTC for twelve elapsed hours.
mechanism.side: opposite the common strict sign of the early and late dollar factors
mechanism.why_distinct: DFSR uses one full-session factor endpoint. HVDBR uses full-session sign breadth. DFDPR forms two nonoverlapping six-pair standardized factors, requires directional persistence, and ranks the weaker phase; it reuses no prior clock or diagnostic control.
mechanism.volatile_market_target: pre-decision BTC 24-hour realized-variation causal rank at least 0.65
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: one sparse weekday 21:05 UTC dual-phase FX clock is absent from Gross9

features.fx_source: bars_polygon 1m rows for six frozen FX pairs on UTC weekdays
features.phase_valid: each pair and phase has at least 225 distinct minutes, first no later than phase+5m, last no earlier than phase end-5m, finite positive coherent OHLC; no imputation
features.canonical_returns: negative log return for EURUSD and GBPUSD; positive log return for USDAUD, USDCAD, USDCHF, and USDJPY, independently by phase
features.pair_zscores: each pair-phase return standardized against at most 90 strictly prior valid same-phase sessions, minimum 60, current excluded, prior sample std positive
features.phase_factors: cross-sectional median of the six finite pair z-scores independently by phase
features.persistence: early and late factors are finite, strict nonzero, and have identical signs
features.weaker_phase_magnitude: minimum of absolute early and late factor
features.persistence_rank: strict-prior midrank of weaker-phase magnitude over at most 90 prior valid persistent sessions, minimum 60, current excluded; rank>=0.60
features.btc_realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared exact completed hourly BTC returns over 24h ending 21:00)
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 90 valid weekday decisions, minimum 60, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.decision: exact weekday 21:00 UTC after both FX phases and BTC variation complete
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding_oi_premium_rv20: not signal inputs; exact funding after novelty; RV20 q90 only after all economics pass

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent two-phase global-dollar persistence transmission mechanism

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no pair, phase, persistence, rank, threshold, variation, side, timing, hold, subset, comparator, or control repair
